title: Men's Running – I Only Run Downhill Embroidered Zip Hoodie

seo.title: Running Zip Up Hoodie for Men – I Only Run Downhill
seo.description: A running zip up hoodie for men: I ONLY RUN DOWNHILL. on the back over a runner with arms wide, plus stitched I ONLY RUN lettering on the chest.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This running zip up hoodie for men is for the runner whose only reliable pace is downhill, zipped on for the start line and the long walk back up.

A smiling runner in a red singlet and black shorts spreads his arms wide while running down a grassy hill beside a red-striped path, in cream, red, navy and green with a worn print texture. I ONLY RUN runs above it and DOWNHILL. below in tall condensed capitals, the last line wider than the first: cream and gold on Black and Navy, navy and amber on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small I ONLY over RUN wordmark in the same condensed capitals as the back is embroidered on the left chest, and the word DOWNHILL is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest I ONLY RUN wordmark and left-cuff DOWNHILL, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the I Only Run Downhill zip hoodie fit?
The I Only Run Downhill running zip up hoodie for men from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this running for men hoodie warm enough for cold start lines?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cold start lines, early trail runs and the climb back to the car well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, I ONLY RUN above the hill and DOWNHILL. below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small I ONLY over RUN wordmark in the same condensed capitals as the back sits on the left chest, and DOWNHILL is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The I ONLY RUN wordmark on the chest and the DOWNHILL cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a runner, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the runner who loves every downhill and skips the uphill. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
